title: Personal Loans Payment Record in PracticePay Patient Financing Payoffs
content:
A PracticePay Patient Financing payoff takes account of the customer's Larkspur Personal Loans.

**Rule.** The personal-loan extra good-through days of a payoff read every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: a payment that came back on any of them within the last 6 months together with a late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 5 days, such a returned payment with no late fee within the last 12 months gives 2 days, and no payment coming back on any of them within the last 6 months gives 0. A window of the last 6 or 12 months covers entries dated fewer than that many whole months before today, a month being whole once today's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

The records read are the returned-payment entries and late-fee entries on the ledgers of all the customer's Personal Loans, whatever their status — open, paid off or charged off.

| Payment came back on any personal loan within 6 months | Late fee posted on any personal loan within 12 months | Extra good-through days |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 5 |
| yes | no | 2 |
| no | yes | 0 |
| no | no | 0 |


## Cases (hypothetical, payoff on 15 October)

- A personal-loan payment came back on 3 August and a late fee posted on that loan on 20 January: both inside their windows, 5 extra days.
- A personal-loan payment came back on 3 August; the last personal-loan late fee posted 14 months ago: 2 extra days.
- The last personal-loan return was 8 months ago, with a late fee 2 months ago: 0 extra days.
